snippet.title: Dating Show & Death Game Suspense VN "Kiss or Kill" Steam Page Now LIVE!
snippet.description:
Kiss or Kill is a suspense visual novel blending romance reality TV with a deadly survival game.

7 days.
200 participants.
One AI host.

Build relationships through dangerous “romance missions” by day, investigate the truth by night, and decide who survives.

■ Multi-route / multiple endings
■ 6 romanceable characters (including 1 hidden route)
■ Dating Show × Death Game

Kiss or Kill
